task: Development speed: path-filtered prek hooks, live tests inside the normal suite, testmon selection, budgeted mutation, fast-forward releases, test debloat
rules: pyproject.toml import-linter contracts and tests/test_architecture.py own the runtime package layers and inner effect ownership; this task changes no cveta2 runtime module. tests/test_integration_tool_boundaries.py keeps scripts/ and tests/ tooling out of the runtime package and keeps the integration lifecycle standard-library only. Development tooling never becomes a runtime dependency.

modules.responsibility: Declare commit-time checks: fast checks always, heavy checks only for code/dependency paths, a lockfile guard, and testmon-selected pytest that includes live tests.
modules.interface: prek install wires pre-commit and commit-msg stages; hook ids are the SKIP= vocabulary used by the release skill.
modules.effects: Runs subprocess checks; ruff format may rewrite files.

modules.responsibility: Live CVAT/MinIO/ClearML tests as part of the normal pytest run: a session fixture resolves the stand, mints and cleans one run tag, and waits with a notice while a stand is stopped.
modules.interface: pytest collects tests/integration with the live marker in one xdist group; -m 'not live' excludes them; CVETA2_STAND_WAIT_TIMEOUT caps the wait; lifecycle.py keeps a manual cleanup command.
modules.layer: Integration test tooling, outside the runtime package.
allowed_dependencies: cveta2 public API in test modules
forbidden_dependencies: being imported by any cveta2 runtime module
SDK or cveta2 imports in lifecycle.py
modules.effects: Owns the run tag, stand objects named by it, subprocesses and the child environment.

modules.responsibility: Change-scoped advisory mutation testing with a time and mutant budget.
modules.interface: python scripts/mutation.py [--base REV] [--budget-seconds N] [--max-functions N] [--keep] [--strict] [FILE...]; exit 0 on completed or budget-limited runs.
modules.layer: Development tooling, outside the runtime package.
allowed_dependencies: git and the repository venv's mutmut as subprocesses
forbidden_dependencies: being imported by any cveta2 runtime module
modules.effects: Owns subprocesses and one temporary workspace per run.

modules.responsibility: Unit tests consolidated by module: duplicates removed, repetition parametrized, round trips as properties.
modules.interface: pytest; package coverage stays at or above fail_under.
allowed_dependencies: pytest plugins in the dev group
forbidden_dependencies: being imported by any cveta2 runtime module
modules.effects: Temporary HOME and fakes only; live effects belong to tests/integration.

contracts.rules: Exhaustive inward layers and adapter independence for the cveta2 package (import-linter).
No cveta2 runtime module imports tests or scripts; negative cases inject both imports.
tests/integration/lifecycle.py imports only the standard library; injected cveta2 and SDK imports must fail.

checks.command: uv run lint-imports && uv run pytest -n 0 -m 'not live' tests/test_architecture.py
checks.expectation: Layer contracts kept; effect fixtures still fail.
Runtime modules import no tooling; lifecycle.py stays standard-library only; injected forbidden imports are reported.

checks.command: time git commit for a docs-only, a code and a uv.lock-only change
checks.expectation: Docs-only runs no pytest/mypy; code runs testmon-selected tests; a lone uv.lock change is rejected.
All tests including live pass with coverage >= fail_under; live tests run in one xdist group and clean their tag.

checks.command: uv run pytest -n 0 tests/test_integration_lifecycle.py and an owner-approved stand stop/start run
checks.expectation: A stopped stand produces a notice, heartbeats and a resume; auth/TLS errors fail at once; timeout and Ctrl-C stop cleanly.

documentation: .specify/memory/constitution.md, .specify/memory/engineering.md, AGENTS.md, scripts/README.md, .agents/skills/{release,running-integration-tests,mutation-testing}; historical specs and plans are not rewritten.
